endangerment.comment: Katxúyana (3099-kbb) = Severely Endangered (80 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (There are now between 8 and 10 Katxuyana villages, all with at least a few fully fluent speakers (people older than 50), and some with even the children speaking the language ... most of the villages are small (... none has even 100 people), and ... many of the young people (defined as 50 and younger) are dominant in Tiriyó,) [Gildea 2014](cldf:gildea:14)
